About AHA Resources Pvt

Built on trust. Grown throughexcellence.

A Pakistani conglomerate of ten owned and operated enterprises, united by one standard of care and one promise: connecting resources, creating experiences.

Our Platform

A diversified business platform

AHA Resources Pvt. is a diversified business platform focused on creating opportunities, connecting resources and developing sustainable ventures across multiple sectors. Our business model brings together tourism, hospitality, retail, automotive services, agriculture, fisheries, international trade, healthcare and professional consultancy under one integrated corporate vision.

We aim to connect

  1. Resources
  2. Expertise
  3. Investment
  4. Opportunities
  5. Markets
  6. Value

Through strategic partnerships and responsible business practices, AHA Resources seeks to build commercially viable ventures with long term growth potential.

Company Overview

A house of enterprises, a family of standards

AHA Resources Pvt was founded on a simple observation: Pakistan's customers and global partners deserve one accountable name across the services they need most, travel, hospitality, food, retail, healthcare, agriculture and trade.

Today the group operates ten divisions, each led by dedicated teams and held to shared benchmarks of quality, transparency and service. We do not franchise our reputation: every outlet, farm, vessel and counter carries our name because we own it, staff it and stand behind it.

Our combined strength lets us do what single line companies cannot , serve a customer's whole journey, from the ticket in their hand to the meal on their table, the medicine in their home and the cargo on the water.

Our ambition: build strong international business relationships, facilitate cross border investment and trade, develop tourism and hospitality opportunities, create integrated business ecosystems, support entrepreneurs and investors, and generate sustainable employment and economic value.

Blogs & Field Stories

Written from the road

Dawn at Borobudur, a consultant's notebook

There is a half hour before the crowds when the stupas hold the only sound on the plateau: wind, and a guide's low voice naming the reliefs. We schedule every Java Heritage group into that half hour. It is the whole reason the alarm exists.

What forty students taught our group tour team

Plane a buffer after every meal, label every bus seat twice, and carry spare batteries like currency. Serious lessons, learned joyfully, now written into our group operating manual.

Farm diary: the first prawn cohort of the season

Water at 29°C, feed conversion on target, and the wholesale desk already booking against the harvest. Traceability tags on every crate, pond to plate, in writing.

Home · CSR & Sustainability

Corporate Social Responsibility

Growth that givesback.

Community development, environmental stewardship, education, healthcare and disaster relief , written into our operating plan, not bolted on at year end.

Five Pillars

Where our responsibility lands

Our principle: Profitability with Purpose. Sustainable practices, local employment, community participation, responsible tourism, environmental awareness, local sourcing, skills development and long term economic value.

Community Development

Local hiring first, village infrastructure projects, and support for artisans and small vendors in every district we operate in.

Environmental Sustainability

Reef safe dive and snorkel codes, farm water stewardship, waste segregation across hotel, restaurant and retail outlets.

Education

Weekend classrooms, scholarships and school tour sponsorships, plus internships that rotate students through all ten divisions.

Healthcare

Subsidised medicine days through our Medical Store, first aid training for staff and community volunteers, and blood donation drives.

Disaster Relief

Standing reserve of food, water and medical supplies from our own shelves and farms, mobilised within hours of a declaration.

Responsible Travel

Community hosted cultural sessions paid at community set rates, group size caps at fragile sites, and leave no trace operations.

Sustainability in Practice

Measured, not merely meant

Every division reports three sustainability indicators each quarter, water, waste and local spend, to the same board that reviews revenue. What gets measured at the top gets done at the counter.

  • Farms:pond water recycling and zero discharge targets
  • Hotel & Restaurant:local first sourcing, single use reduction
  • Travel:reef safe operations and community set cultural rates
  • Retail:dated stock discipline to cut food waste

Legal & Policies

The fine print, inplain language.

Our commitments to your privacy, your money and your data, summarised honestly. Full documents available on request.

Privacy Policy

We collect only what a booking, order or application requires: name, contact details and the specifics of your request. We never sell personal data. Data is shared only with providers necessary to fulfil your request (airlines, hotels, couriers) and retained only as long as needed or as law requires. You may request a copy or deletion of your data at any time via[email protected].

Terms & Conditions

Services across our divisions are provided under the confirmation issued for each booking or order. Prices are quoted inclusive of stated taxes unless noted. Travel services are additionally governed by carrier and hotelier terms. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited. Disputes are governed by the laws of Pakistan and addressed first through our customer desk.

Refund Policy

Retail, restaurant and service division purchases: refunds or exchanges within the posted window with receipt, except perishables and opened personal care items. Travel and hotel: refunds follow the cancellation schedule stated on your confirmation; supplier imposed penalties are passed through at cost with documentation. Wholesale: credit notes for verified quality claims within 48 hours of delivery.

Cookie Policy

This website sets no advertising or tracking cookies. Only functional storage (for example, your saved preferences) is used in your own browser and never leaves your device. Third party embeds, if added later (maps, video), will be listed here with their own cookie notices.
